description: This PHP script is used to generate printable views of test case information within the TestLink project. It initializes the page, processes request parameters, and renders HTML output for a specific test case, utilizing external configurations, templates, and rendering functions.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic empty class used for creating objects dynamically.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes request parameters related to test case ID, version, project, and output format.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with details about the output format, page title, and test case node information for rendering.
